chain_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX security_audit_chain_entries_event_hash_key ON public.security_audit_chain_entries USING btree (event_hash)

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_authorization_decision_par ON public.security_audit_events USING btree (authorization_tenant_id, authorization_par_uri) WHERE (((event_type)::text = 'authorization_decision_committed'::text) AND (authorization_par_uri IS NOT NULL))

indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_authorization_decision_reclaim ON public.security_audit_events USING btree (business_retain_until, event_id) WHERE (((event_type)::text = 'authorization_decision_committed'::text) AND (exported_at IS NOT NULL))

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_authorization_decision_request ON public.security_audit_events USING btree (authorization_tenant_id, authorization_request_id) WHERE ((event_type)::text = 'authorization_decision_committed'::text)
